name: key-model-v2-reference-vectors
description: Self-contained NULO-ACCOUNT-KDF v2 reference project. Run: bun install && bun derive-vectors.ts > vectors.json — from THIS directory. Imports ONLY the published 5.0.1 packages plus node:crypto (a deliberately DIFFERENT PBKDF2 implementation than the wallet's WebCrypto, for cross-implementation verification); never the repo's own helpers.
